spatialBlueprint.headline: Rooftop Sundowner Lounge & Neon Memory Gallery
spatialBlueprint.description: An intimate panoramic terrace with plush lounge clusters, an artisanal cocktail lab, and an illuminated interactive memory installation celebrating life milestones.
spatialBlueprint.lightingArchitecture: Golden-hour ambient string festoon canopy, warm 2700K uplighting on botanical planters, and subtle retro neon custom monogram over the DJ booth.
spatialBlueprint.olfactoryTactileSignature: Infused bergamot citrus and sandalwood candle scent, textured velvet lounge cushions, brushed bronze bar accessories.
spatialBlueprint.decibelRegulations: Open-air acoustic sundowner until 21:30; transitions to indoor high-fidelity sound lounge after 22:00 in compliance with municipal norms.

personalizedIdeas.title: Signature "Year in Flavor" Cocktail Flight
personalizedIdeas.description: A curated 3-drink tasting flight where each artisanal cocktail represents a defining era or memorable trip in the honoree’s life.
personalizedIdeas.impact: Sparks conversation and deeply personal storytelling among guests.

personalizedIdeas.title: Interactive Audio Guestbook & Polaroid Wall
personalizedIdeas.description: A vintage rotary phone where guests record voicemail toasts, coupled with an instant film booth with copper pegboards for spontaneous photo keepsakes.
personalizedIdeas.impact: Provides an irreplaceable audio-visual emotional keepsake for the host.

personalizedIdeas.title: Midnight Flame & Artisanal Cake Reveal
personalizedIdeas.description: A tiered architectural confection unveiled with low-smoke sparklers and a synchronized brass-trio fanfare leading into live DJ sets.
personalizedIdeas.impact: Peak celebratory highlight of the evening.

personalizedIdeas.title: Personalized Botanical Scent Souvenirs
personalizedIdeas.description: Pocket-sized custom room mists hand-blended with the evening’s signature amber-bergamot scent profile for each guest to take home.
personalizedIdeas.impact: Long-lasting emotional recall of the milestone celebration.

budgetRebalance.arbitrageInsight: Negotiating a combined venue & sound package with in-house mixology saved ₹65,000, allowing upgrade to a premium 3-tier artisanal cake and live vinyl DJ.

aiPlans.inputPrompt: Plan a traditional Sangeet & Reception evening for 320 guests at an outdoor lakeside pavilion. Prioritize authentic Rajasthani catering, warm ambient brass lanterns, acoustic Sufi ensemble, and keep total decor strictly under ₹7,50,000.

spatialBlueprint.headline: Central Floating Stage & Tuberose Chandeliers
spatialBlueprint.description: A bespoke floating stage overlooking Lake Pichola with cascading 2700K fairy lights and authentic hand-beaten brass urlis.
spatialBlueprint.lightingArchitecture: Continuous 2700K amber canopy overhead with 140 clustered brass floor lamps along the promenade. Zero synthetic floodlights; soft directional wash onto historic stone pillars.
spatialBlueprint.olfactoryTactileSignature: Subtle vaporized rosewater misting along arrival stairs, handwoven raw tussar silk table runners, and pure beeswax candle scent profiles paired with fresh sweet rajnigandha.
spatialBlueprint.decibelRegulations: Outdoor lakeside sound cutoff set for 22:00 IST in accordance with Udaipur Lakefront Preservation Regulations. Acoustic lounge indoor transition certified.

budgetRebalance.arbitrageInsight: By substituting imported white orchids with indigenous wild Rajnigandha and seasonal Genda blossoms from Pushkar wholesale mandis, the studio unlocked ₹1,40,000 in immediate floral savings. This surplus was automatically rechanneled to the dual acoustic monitor system required for the lakeside open-air Sufi performance.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Shehnai Prelude
itinerary.description: Guests arrive via illuminated boat transfer. Traditional Mewari Shehnai & Nagada welcome at the stone jetty, accompanied by gentle fresh rose petal shower and fragrant sandalwood chandan tilak.

itinerary.title: Twilight Sundowner & Acoustic Sufi Set
itinerary.description: Ambient brass hurricane lanterns spark as dusk settles. Nizami acoustic ensemble commences 45-minute semi-classical Sufi set. Signature royal saffron-infused cocktails and live chaat counters open.

itinerary.title: Grand Couple Entry & Cold Pyro Cascade
itinerary.description: High-tempo live dhol procession escorting Ananya and Rohan onto the central floating dais. 6-point synchronized cold pyro sparklers timed to the chorus drop with floral explosion.

itinerary.title: Royal Mewari Banquet & Family Performances
itinerary.description: Full copper-service royal buffet opens. 8 scheduled choreographed family dance performances on stage interspersed with speech toasts.

itinerary.title: Intimate After-Hours Heritage Lounge
itinerary.description: Sound levels modulated to heritage municipal norms. Unplugged indie-acoustic transition, hot dessert stations (Ghewar & Malpua), and lounge seating around floating fire bowls.

culinaryAteliers.title: Royal Bajra & Dal Baati Churma Ateliers
culinaryAteliers.description: Live slow-cooked Daal Baati baked over coal embers in brass sigris with five distinct artisanal churned ghee churmas (Rose, Almond, Cardamom, Dry Fig, Regular).

culinaryAteliers.title: Botanical Saffron & Vetiver Infusions
culinaryAteliers.description: Low-ABV and zero-proof handcrafted elixirs featuring smoked Udaipur royal rose essence, spiced dried plum reductions, and clarified citrus tonics served in hand-cut glass tumblers.
